metaTitle: Custom Running Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom running lanyards and badges for marathons, 5Ks, and events. Fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints!
introHtml: Whether you're organizing a charity 5K, corporate fun run, or marathon, custom running lanyards and badges keep participants organized and your brand visible. Choose durable materials like polyester with breakaway clasps for safety during activity. Add your logo, event name, or bib numbers to create keepsakes that runners will actually wear. From bulldog clips to badge reels, we offer options that stay secure during movement.
heroAltText: Custom running lanyards and badges with breakaway clasps and printed logos for marathon events
